metadata.summary: Native workbench.panel fixture row for failure isolation.
metadata.description: The primary workbench.panel fixture row tests that a failure in the secondary row does not affect it.

zh-CN.summary: 用于失败隔离测试的原生 workbench.panel fixture 行。
zh-CN.description: 第一行声明 workbench.panel，用于验证第二行失败时不会影响第一行。

metadata.summary: Native ui:sidebar fixture row that fails on purpose.
metadata.description: The secondary ui:sidebar fixture row throws during apply to test that the primary row is unaffected.

zh-CN.summary: 故意失败的原生 ui:sidebar 测试 fixture 行。
zh-CN.description: 第二行声明 ui:sidebar，并在应用阶段故意抛出错误，用来验证第一行不受影响。

metadata.summary: Native UI failure isolation fixture. The second row fails on purpose.
metadata.description: The workbench.panel row tests isolation when the ui:sidebar row throws during apply. The official workbench does not load these native panels.

zh-CN.summary: 原生界面失败隔离测试 fixture，第二行故意失败。
zh-CN.description: 第二行 ui:sidebar 在应用阶段抛出错误，用来验证第一行 workbench.panel 不受影响。官方工作台不会加载这两个原生面板。
